name: gizza-ai/har-validator
summary: Validate a HAR (HTTP Archive) file's structure

tool.description: Validate a HAR (HTTP Archive) file against the HAR 1.2 spec: checks the log/entries shape, every required request, response, content, cache, and timings field (with the exact JSON path of each problem), and — when check_timings is true (default) — that each entry's total time equals the sum of its timing phases. Reports ALL problems found, not just the first, and returns a readable report for both valid and invalid HARs (only non-JSON input is an error). Runs locally.

check_timings.description: Also check that each entry's total time equals the sum of its timing phases (blocked, dns, connect, send, wait, receive); phases of -1 are excluded. Reported as warnings. Default true.

har.description: The HAR (HTTP Archive) file contents as JSON text — a single { "log": … } object with entries.
